title: Fairy Souls
description: An up-to-date easy fairy soul finder! (Pathfinding)
body:
# Fairy Finder (26.1 to 26.1.2)  

This mod helps you find every fairy souls, pathfinding and waypoint!

### Features  
 **Pathfinding** – Tries to give out nice path everyone can access!

--- 

### Commands


`/fairysoul` (subcategory)
 - `clear` (Reset the waypoints of the area to go through fairy souls again!)
 - `toggle` (Disable/Enable)
--- 

### Screenshots
![Meow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d7a9d5be64071aeb290d9aa55c32d7988bcea70.jpeg)

##  Additional Information  
- This mod does **not** automate walking or uses an automatic walking algorithm.
